COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
U12.03.2025 Recall Application No. MCC/2/2024
In
FA No. 213 of 2022
UHon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
UHon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. M.S. Bisht, Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. Shivanand Bhatt, Advocate for the respondent.
2. Mr. Shivanand Bhatt, learned counsel appearing for
respondent-wife submits that the order sought to be recalled,
was passed in the absence of the respondent.
3. He submits that amount of Rupees Ten Lakhs, which
was directed to be paid to his client, is grossly inadequate as
respondent is only 32 years old, and she has her entire life
ahead and she cannot make both ends meet with the meagre
amount of Rupees Ten Lakhs for her entire life.
4. He further submits that stridhan and jewellery of the
respondent is still lying with the appellant-husband, which
has not been returned by him.
5. The matter is adjourned to 16.04.2025, to enable Mr.
Shivanand Bhatt, learned counsel, to get instruction as to
whether respondent is ready to return the amount credited
in her account by the appellant pursuant to order dated
20.06.2024.
6. Appellant's counsel shall also get instructions regarding
return of jewellery and other articles to the respondent.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 12.03.2025
Mahinder/
